description: Add a single lead to a campaign this account owns. Requires campaign_id plus at least a phone or an email; deduplicates against the account's existing leads by contact detail. Writes a record only — sends nothing, to nobody, ever.

campaign_id.description: The campaign this lead belongs to (required — every lead lives in a campaign).

name.description: Full name, if first/last are not given separately.

phone.description: Any common format; at least one of phone/email is required.

name: create_lead
title: Create lead
